caption: Nothing recorded
text: The interpreter writes this document when the row settles. The step is still in flight, so nobody has recorded one yet.

caption: Purged
text: Kept 90 days. The step’s counts and outcome stay on the record; its input, its output and its log were removed when the run aged out.

caption: None declared
text: The step was dispatched read-only, and the world it ran under allows no write on the graph data layer. A read that changes a graph would be the bug; a read that says so is the record.
